Only tapping Upload sends up to 1,000 recent redacted log lines. No automatic uploads. Retrying after a timeout or partial ingestion may create duplicates; identify them by event_id.

Enter the full ingestion URL and Authorization. Use {HeadUnit}-{DeviceID} for the stream to insert the head unit model and device hash. Plain example URLs also work. Use HTTPS and dedicated ingestion credentials. HTTP is unencrypted.
